articles.title: OpenAI Says It's Made Progress on a Second $1 Million Math Problem
articles.description: Days after its disputed Navier-Stokes claim, OpenAI says it's made "substantial progress" on another Millennium Prize math problem—and won't say which one yet.

articles.title: CFTC expands regulatory relief for passive trading software providers
articles.description: The US regulator’s move could make it easier for crypto wallets and other apps to offer access to regulated derivatives and prediction markets without registering as introducing brokers.

articles.title: Trump photo appears to reference Kennedy Center demolition, judge orders advance notice of any move to knock it down
articles.description: President Donald Trump wants his name on the Kennedy Center. But a judge has ruled it cannot be placed there without authorization by Congress.

articles.title: As Republicans tout Trump's 'big beautiful bill,' here's who the tax breaks benefited most
articles.description: As the midterm elections approach, Republicans are touting President Donald Trump's "big beautiful bill" to voters. Here's who benefited from the tax cuts.

articles.title: Intel and Micron lead our portfolio higher, and J&J strengthens our case for owning it
articles.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

articles.title: Ethereum Founder Vitalik Buterin Says AI Won’t Doom Crypto Security
articles.description: The Ethereum co-founder said AI could help developers mathematically verify entire software systems, turning the same technology powering new attacks into a tool for defense.

articles.title: Oil prices fall as Saudi Arabia reportedly offers more crude via Hormuz after pipeline attack
articles.description: Oil prices fell as additional Saudi crude supplies eased concerns over disruptions to the kingdom’s exports.

articles.title: Kevin O’Leary says Congress will revisit Clarity early next year as crypto tax bill advances
articles.description: The Shark Tank investor says Congress will face pressure to revive crypto market structure legislation as it moves to establish tax rules for digital assets.

articles.title: SEC opens door to tokenized U.S. stock trading. Here’s who could benefit
articles.description: The five-year experiment gives DeFi-style trading venues, tokenization firms and liquidity providers a new U.S. pathway while leaving synthetic stock tokens outside the framework.

articles.title: Bill to curb AI data center utility costs hits snag in Senate
articles.description: Sen. Martin Heinrich, D-N.M., blocked bipartisan legislation aimed at reining in data center-related utility cost increases, calling the bill a half-measure.

articles.title: Jensen Huang says Nvidia will sell twice as many chips next year
articles.description: Huang's comment is the latest forecast from Nvidia and points to continuing massive growth for the next six quarters.

articles.title: Andrew Yang Calls for AI Kill Switch as Safety Fears Mount
articles.description: The former presidential candidate said lawmakers should impose liability rules and waiting periods on frontier AI firms as autonomous agents raise new cyber and labor concerns.

articles.title: Securitize jumps after regulators greenlight some tokenized U.S. stock trading
articles.description: Securitize surged Thursday after federal regulators greenlit the issuing of tokenized stocks on some trading platforms in the U.S.

articles.title: Amid calls for urgent AI action from Congress, House heads home to campaign
articles.description: The urgency with which Anthropic, OpenAI and xAI have sought to be regulated has not translated into action on Capitol Hill.

articles.title: King Charles Convenes OpenAI, Anthropic, Nvidia and Google for AI Safety Summit
articles.description: King Charles hosted senior AI executives at his Scottish estate to discuss keeping the technology "in the service of humanity," days after industry leaders called for a slowdown.

articles.title: WisdomTree, MoonPay team up to expand US access to tokenized money market fund
articles.description: MoonPay plans to use WisdomTree’s $1.2 billion WTGXX tokenized fund as part of its stablecoin reserves while helping expand access to US investors.

articles.title: Stephen Curry says his Li-Ning signature shoe will debut early next year
articles.description: Golden State Warrior superstar Stephen Curry announced in June he was signing a long-term partnership with Chinese brand Li-Ning.

articles.title: How record diesel prices will rip through the U.S. economy. Trucks, rails are only the start
articles.description: Record diesel prices are already walloping the transportation sector, and if energy prices stay high, the economic impact will spread.

articles.title: Bitcoin Bounces as Markets Brace for the Fed’s Next Move
articles.description: The Federal Reserve's first rate increase since 2023 barely dented crypto prices, but what comes next could change calculations on Wall Street.

articles.title: Is there any chance left to save the CLARITY Act?
articles.description: CLARITY isn’t dead after failing a key Senate vote, but with time running short and Democrats still demanding changes, its path forward is narrowing.
